_readme: Each parameter has a 'value' (edit this) and a 'description' (explanation, ignored by the script). Formula: CCE = L * { (Y + floor(m*N_CCE_p / (L*M_max_L)) + n_CI) mod floor(N_CCE_p/L) } + i   (TS 38.213, Sec 10.1)

coreset_id.description: CORESET index p. For USS it selects A_p: p mod 3 = 0 -> 39827, 1 -> 39829, 2 -> 39830. Not used in the CSS calculation (Y = 0).

search_space_id.description: Search space index s, as configured in SIB1 / RRC. Informational only, not used in the formula.

search_space_type.description: 'CSS' = Common Search Space (Y = 0, same CCEs every slot). 'USS' = UE-specific Search Space (Y derived from RNTI and slot).

aggregation_level.description: Aggregation Level L = number of CCEs per PDCCH candidate. Allowed: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16. Also sets the CCE offset range i = 0 .. L-1.

num_candidates.description: Number of PDCCH candidates configured for this AL in the search space (M_s,nCI^(L)). Candidate index m runs 0 .. num_candidates-1. Defaults to M_max_L if omitted.

M_max_L.description: M_s,max^(L): the maximum number of PDCCH candidates for this AL over all carriers (equals num_candidates when there is no cross-carrier scheduling). Used as the divisor that spreads candidates across the CORESET.

N_CCE_p.description: Total number of CCEs in CORESET p = (CORESET RBs in frequency / 6) x (CORESET duration in OFDM symbols). 1 CCE = 6 REGs = 6 RBs x 1 symbol.

slot.description: Slot number n^mu_s,f within the radio frame, based on the numerology in which the UE decodes PDCCH. Only affects USS (Y is recomputed each slot); ignored for CSS.

n_CI.description: Carrier indicator field value. Use 0 if cross-carrier scheduling is not configured for the serving cell.

rnti.description: C-RNTI of the UE, used as Y_p,-1 for the USS hash (Y_p,n = (A_p * Y_p,n-1) mod 65537). Must be non-zero for USS. Leave 0 for CSS.
